_meta.title: Local visibility of the solar and lunar eclipse records
_meta.scope: The records in data/records/{solar,lunar}/*.jsonl that were not plainly visible from their place, keyed by record_id. A record without a row was visible.

fields.bucket: solar: low-sun | grazing | night | no-reach; lunar: horizon | deep; either: untested
fields.local_mag: (solar) greatest magnitude while the Sun is above the horizon
fields.alt_at_peak: (solar) solar altitude in degrees at closest approach of the shadow axis
fields.sun_alt: (solar) solar altitude in degrees at local_mag; null when local_mag is 0
fields.max_alt: (lunar) greatest geocentric lunar altitude in degrees during the eclipse

_meta.provenance: Derived by tools/build-visibility.mjs from the Besselian elements in data/eclipses/ and the coordinates in data/concordance/gazetteer.json; thresholds in tools/lib/local-visibility.mjs. Independent of the record field source_claim.
